entities.name: Juan Antonio Ugarte Pérez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juan Antonio Ugarte Pérez is a Peruvian clergyman and auxiliary bishop for the Roman Catholic Diocese of Abancay, and later for Cuzco and Yauyos. He became ordained in 1967. He was appointed bishop in 1983. He retired in 2014.
